BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Sherry are delighted to present No. 1 Knightsfield Crescent, a substantial detached family residence occupying a prime position within this mature and highly regarded development in Dunsany Village.

Extending to approximately 166 sq.m., this impressive home offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout, perfectly suited to modern family living. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious sitting room centred around a feature solid fuel stove, an open-plan kitchen/dining area, utility room, guest WC and a versatile fifth bedroom which could equally serve as a home office, playroom or study.

Upstairs, there are four generously sized bedrooms including a large principal suite complete with walk-in wardrobe and ensuite shower room. A well-appointed family bathroom and spacious landing complete the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, the property enjoys a private south-facing rear garden which is not overlooked and has been designed for low-maintenance enjoyment. To the front, there is ample off-street parking and a pleasant outlook across the development.

Combining village charm with excellent accessibility to Dunshaughlin, Trim, Navan and Dublin City, No. 1 Knightsfield Crescent represents an exceptional opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in a highly convenient setting.

Gardens & Grounds

The property enjoys a private south-facing rear garden which benefits from excellent sunshine throughout the day. Designed with ease of maintenance in mind, the garden provides an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining and family enjoyment.

The rear garden is not directly overlooked, creating a wonderful sense of privacy. A garden shed provides useful outdoor storage, while dual side access points add practicality and convenience.

To the front, the property is set behind a low boundary wall with a spacious driveway providing ample off-street parking.

Location

Knightsfield Crescent is a small and established residential development located in the picturesque village of Dunsany, one of County Meath's most sought-after rural settings.

The property is positioned adjacent to Dunsany GAA Club and within walking distance of Dunsany National School, making it particularly attractive for growing families. Dunsany offers a strong sense of community and is renowned for its attractive village setting and proximity to the historic Dunsany Castle Estate.

Dunshaughlin is just 6km away, providing an excellent range of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools and everyday amenities. Kilmessan, Trim and Navan are all within easy reach, while the M3 motorway provides straightforward access to Dublin City and Dublin Airport.

The 109B bus route passes through Dunsany village and provides a regular service to Dublin City. The M3 Parkway Rail Station at Dunboyne can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this an excellent location for commuters seeking a balance between country living and urban convenience.
